svg.title: Card mode share text: the card as a 45-glyph staircase
svg.desc: Two share messages. Left, English: ozterisk Card, Run Complete, Rounds 45, Score 32, Longest streak 6, then nine lines of filled and hollow squares growing from one to nine glyphs, one per fact. Right, Korean: a lost run, rounds 38, score 23, longest streak 11, with the same staircase where hollow squares mark facts missed or never dealt. Notes below explain the row order and that both glyphs are not emoji code points.

text.font-family: 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
